items.title: Iran considering US proposal to end war, official says
items.description: The White House reportedly believes it could be closing in on a 14-point memorandum of understanding with Iran.

items.title: Trump's hopes for an Iran peace deal come with caveats
items.description: There are signs of fresh momentum to end the war, but Trump himself has injected a note of caution.

items.title: Israel strikes Beirut for first time since Hezbollah ceasefire
items.description: Israel says it targeted a senior Hezbollah figure in the capital, the first strike of its kind since mid-April.

items.title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship leaves Cape Verde after three evacuated
items.description: A British man is among three evacuees sent to the Netherlands after displaying symptoms while aboard the MV Hondius.

items.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
items.description: Reports have raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran after days of escalation.

items.title: Ted Turner, media mogul who revolutionised TV news by launching CNN, dies at 87
items.description: The media mogul pioneered the modern 24-hour news culture when he launched the Cable News Network in 1980.

items.title: German tourist wins payout after losing sun lounger race
items.description: The man sued his tour operator for allowing people to reserve sun loungers with towels despite a hotel ban on the practice.

items.title: Massive Alaska megatsunami was second largest ever recorded
items.description: New research suggests glacier melt driven by climate change is increasing the risk of giant waves.

items.title: Orphaned baby hippo to be hand-reared by keepers at Kenya sanctuary
items.description: The baby hippo, which has been named Bumpy, was found clinging to its lifeless mother at a lake.

items.title: To stay or risk the 'Road of Death' - Ukrainian civilians trapped in frontline city
items.description: People in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky say they have been cut off from fresh supplies of food or medicine for months.

items.title: German police raid neo-Nazi criminal youth groups
items.description: Police search locations in 12 states, mainly in the East and South of the country in what prosecutors say is a targeted raid.

items.title: Russia ignores Ukraine's unilateral ceasefire and attacks kindergarten
items.description: Ukraine's president says Russia has "spurned the ceasefire" and Kyiv is deciding on further action to take.
